svg.title: A patient with chronic pain: assess everyone, then decide whether the distress is more than chronic pain. If not, manage biologically, psychologically and by rehabilitation. If so, tell somatic symptom disorder, conversion disorder, factitious disorder and malingering apart by whether the behaviour is conscious and whether the gain is external, and assess and manage each
